title: Walk in order
prompt: Return the values of the tree in in-order: everything in the left subtree, then the node, then everything in the right subtree. An empty tree gives an empty array.
hints: What does the function return for null? That is the base case.
Get the values of the left subtree and of the right subtree with two recursive calls.
Return the left values, then root.value, then the right values, joined into one array.
checkLabels: The sample is a binary search tree, so in-order gives its values from smallest to largest.
An empty tree gives an empty array.
Left, then the node, then right.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Lists the node before its left subtree.

feedback: Work it out by hand for a root with two children. The order is left child, root, right child.
